name: marmalade-open-press
description: Marmalade Open Press: turn an HTML page into a print-ready CMYK PDF/X-4, with clean blacks. Made by Marmalade (https://marmalade.family).

scripts.example: node bin/open-press.js examples/poster.html examples/poster.pdf --bleed 3 --check && node bin/open-press.js examples/back-cover.html examples/back-cover.pdf --check
